opening.argument: The speaker presents his Litecoin assessment as personal market commentary, not a guaranteed result. He explicitly says he could be wrong and calls it his opinion, even while describing Litecoin as a strong buy and saying he plans to buy some himself. His optimistic view includes a possible 10X return only if held for a couple of years, and his prediction of steady gains with very little risk is tempered by an acknowledgment that the price could move down. Read together, these are market judgments expressed with stated uncertainty, not promises of an outcome.
